measurement: One fresh Node process per implementation. Identical input is constructed and byte-counted before explicit GC. Wall timing covers canonicalizeSource including parsing, validation and reconstruction; excludes process startup, fixture construction and output hashing. Heap delta is heapUsed immediately after minus before the call, without post-call GC: it includes collectible temporaries and is neither peak nor retained heap. Local single-run measurements, not production latency estimates.

deterministicRegression.measurement: Sum of result.length across String.prototype.slice calls during synchronous canonicalizeSource, restored in finally. Counts logical UTF-16 slice lengths, not actual V8 memory copies.

complexity.notation: N input length, L rendered output length, B safe blocks
complexity.reconstructionBefore: O(B * max(N, L) + B log B) worst case
complexity.additionalSpaceAfter: O(L + B) for rendered chunks and reconstruction; input and parsing state are shared
complexity.scope: Reconstruction only; lexical parsing, metadata checks and parser block ordering remain unchanged.
